title: anthoxanthum gunckelii
intro: Anthoxanthum gunckelii, commonly known as sweet grass, is a perennial grass native to North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Anthoxanthum gunckelii include its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and protect against oxidative damage. The bioactive constituents of sweet grass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
